title: fix(console): on a phone, a page the assistant opens closes its sheet
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8JRuu4biowMGgDVcNVcsSp)_
Fixes #37556
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：在手机上用应用内 AI，点回答下方的引用后，AI 对话面板自动收起，直接看到被标出的那一段；再打开 AI 面板，还是原来的对话。电脑上面板照旧留在页面旁边。
- 为什么做：记录 AI 问询专题里引用条的跟进，原先手机上点引用像没反应，要手动关面板才看得到。
- 出错会怎样：手机上点 AI 里的链接后面板该收不收或不该收时收起；对话和数据不受影响，撤回本次合并即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/useConsoleChatDock.tsx`: on a phone (the drawer is a bottom sheet over the page), the host closes the sheet when the location moves by a PUSH or POP away from the history entry (`location.key`) the sheet was shown open on. A PUSH onto the same URL counts (a second click on the same citation chip carries fresh section state to the same URL). A REPLACE never closes it: a page rewriting its own query, the host's handoff hand-over, and an old `/ai…` link landing with the drawer armed open all stay as they were.
- The entry the sheet was shown on is kept per tab in sessionStorage (`ai-chat-dock-sheet-shown-at`, cleared whenever the sheet is closed), not in the hook: a chip in a sheet opened over Home lands on an app's record through another layout, which mounts a new dock host that never saw the navigation (found by the first booted check). Where sessionStorage throws, a module copy stands in, so the rule still works for the life of the page.
- Review rework (contract review 7195408408, seat REWORK 7195422188):
  - S1: the move away is noted on the navigation itself, before the phone check. `useIsMobile` answers `false` on a host's first render; an app named by its alias lands through `AppContent`, which REPLACEs the address on mount, so a rule judged only once the flag settled saw that REPLACE and kept the sheet open.
  - N1: at a desktop width (read off the window, since `useIsMobile`'s first-render `false` cannot tell) the entry is dropped, so turning a tablet portrait, landscape, portrait does not close the drawer on the turn.
  - S2: a POP case is pinned. N3: the storage-failure jsdoc is corrected and the in-memory fallback added. N2 and N4 accepted as they are.
- The rule lives in the host, not at the chip: every navigation the chat makes on a phone (citation chip, `open_record`, list link, open-form) now reveals the page; the chip's click path is not touched.
- The conversation is kept: closing only collapses the sheet; the dock target is untouched, so reopening shows the same thread. Desktop rail and the full-window rule are unchanged.
- Changeset `.changeset/37556-phone-dock-closes-on-citation.md` (patch, `@object-ui/app-shell`).

Read first: `useConsoleChatDock.tsx`, the effect under the full-window one and the storage helpers above `hasHandoff`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/useConsoleChatDock.phoneCollapseOnNavigate-37556.test.tsx` (9): the real host, `useChatDockState` and router; `useIsMobile` is a stand-in with the real hook's timing (`false` on the first render, measured in its mount effect, again on resize); stand-in sheet/rail. Cases: a phone chip click (PUSH) closes the sheet and reopening with no target shows the same conversation; a same-URL re-click closes it; Back (POP) closes it; a chip from Home into an app (two layouts, two hosts) closes it and reopening shows the same thread; the alias landing (a parent `AppContent`-shaped redirect REPLACEs on mount while the new host's flag is held back one task) closes it; with `window.sessionStorage` throwing, a chip click closes it; a same-page REPLACE leaves it open; a tablet turn to landscape, a chip click there, and a turn back leaves the drawer open; CONTROL: at desktop width the rail stays open after a chip click.
- The new tests against the previous head's hook (b220ce83): 3 failed (alias landing, storage throwing, tablet turn), 6 passed.
- Ablation (the `collapse()` call replaced by a no-op): 6 failed, 3 passed (every closing case red; the REPLACE case, the tablet turn and the desktop control green); restored 9/9.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1 (test): above.
- Acceptance 2 (booted-console phone check): see Verification.

## Verification

- Local on e4692c39: the new test 9/9; `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` exit 0; derived gate families: see the report. The package's whole suite is left to CI's `Test UI` (test-run scope, not a Clause-② narrowing).
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/useConsoleChatDock.phoneCollapseOnNavigate-37556.test.tsx`, expected 9 passed.
- Booted-console phone check (iPhone 13 profile). Showcase app (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`) with the `ui/` console dev server pointed at it, on `main` (which now carries PR #37539, so history draws chips) merged with this branch. **Injected, not produced**: no producer emits the citations part before cloud 10c, so the run serves the conversation-history read with an answer carrying a `data-record-citations` part, and a one-agent catalog because the boot has no model.
  - Package address: the old `/ai/ask/CONVERSATION` link lands on Home with the sheet open and 3 chips. Chip click: `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_field_zoo/record/ID?section=contractor-scope`, sheet gone (0 in the DOM), the marked heading `Contractor scope` at top 45 px, in view. Reopening: the same 3 chips. The same chip again: sheet gone, heading in view.
  - Alias path (S1): the object read is served with the app's NAME (`showcase_app`) as its package, so the chip lands on `/apps/showcase_app/…` and the app shell REPLACEs it with `/apps/com.example.showcase/…`. Sheet gone, heading at top 45 px, in view; reopening shows the same chips; the same chip again closes it again.
  - Screenshots: `objectstack-seat5/ai-36996/shots-37556/` in the project files (`phone-dock-*.png` and `phone-alias-dock-*.png`, four each, plus the script).
